board: Adafruit NeoKey 1x4 QT I2C - Four Mechanical Key Switches with NeoPixels (product 4980, ATSAMD09 seesaw)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico on the first run. Modelled as seesaw over I2C with 16-bit base/function addressing: HW_ID 0x55, GPIO_BULK 0x01/0x04 byte 3 bits 4-7 are keys A-D (active low). The driver also drives the NeoPixels (seesaw pin 3, NEOPIXEL base 0x0E); the simulator accepts those writes but does not show the colours. Header order VIN, 3, -, C, D, INT comes from Adafruit's schematic (JP1/JP5) and fab print.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://learn.adafruit.com/neokey-1x4-qt-i2c/downloads (schematic adafruit_products_NK14_sch.png JP1/JP5 pins 1-6 and fab print silkscreen) and https://learn.adafruit.com/neokey-1x4-qt-i2c/pinouts
